prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website direction comp, 1536×1024 landscape
Primary request: Render a polished evolution of the existing Aljohn Polyglot translation-services page using the Dual-Lane Workbench composition. Keep the recognizable conveyor-belt translation-engine concept and stay close to the incumbent page rather than inventing a new brand.
Input images: Image 1 is the current translation-conveyor crop. It contributes the midnight navy field, subtle plus-sign pattern, horizontal national-flag belt, cyan glass engine, and yellow accent. It must NOT force the current hard-coded spacing, tiny engine, or centered-only layout.
Structure: preserve the real shared global navbar at top. First viewport below it uses a fluid 40/60 split. Left rail contains eyebrow “Translation Services”, exact headline “Your Words, Accurately Conveyed, Culturally Resonant.”, the existing concise subtitle, and yellow primary action “Request Your Translation Quote”. Right region is a working translation desk with two strong horizontal conveyor lanes: an upper SOURCE lane carrying crisp flags for Spanish, French, Indonesian, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, German, and Cebuano; a central cyan glass panel labeled exactly “TRANSLATION ENGINE”; and a lower OUTPUT lane resolving into two larger labeled destinations, “ENGLISH” and “TAGALOG”. The engine visibly bridges the lanes. Beneath the split, show the beginning of the real service content as one calm full-width ledger: “Why Entrust Me With Your Translations?” with three concise columns “Deep Immersion Advantage”, “Meticulous Attention”, “Cultural Sensitivity”. Show enough second fold to prove continuation.
Style/medium: realistic shippable product UI screenshot, not concept art. Clean technical editorial grid, practical HTML/CSS-feasible geometry, restrained glow only around the engine, clear typography.
Color palette: midnight navy #081a38, deep blue #102a56, cyan #00a9ff, warm yellow #ffdb00, white #ffffff, sparse Philippine red #c8102e.
Materials/textures: flat dark control surface, thin cyan signal rules, crisp flag tiles, lightly frosted engine glass, quiet white service ledger.
Text (verbatim where shown): “Aljohn Polyglot”; “Translation Services”; “Your Words, Accurately Conveyed, Culturally Resonant.”; “Request Your Translation Quote”; “SOURCE”; “TRANSLATION ENGINE”; “OUTPUT”; “ENGLISH”; “TAGALOG”; “Why Entrust Me With Your Translations?”; “Deep Immersion Advantage”; “Meticulous Attention”; “Cultural Sensitivity”.
Constraints: conveyor mechanism must dominate; no fake reviews, stats, certifications, clients, or prices; do not invent nav items; realistic responsive proportions, not fixed pixel measurements; visible CTA; high contrast; conventional accessible controls; no watermark.
Avoid: unrelated sci-fi cockpit, excessive neon, glassmorphism everywhere, rounded-card dashboard, fake logos, device mockup, browser chrome, illegible microtext, generic corporate stock photography, removing the conveyor.
